description: ZipWall bathroom magnetic door tips…I’m adding a @zipwall_llc magnetic door to this bathroom. The double-sided tape sticks to the door jamb and the magnetic door bonds to it. This keeps dust and debris from the getting into the bedroom. The door can be reused for other projects.
